text_block_list.text:
In a dark corner of the school building, Nakayama Festa
was talking to Sirius Symboli about something...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —So, which prey do you want?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The lively one over there, or
the calm one over here...
Heh, pick whichever one suits your fancy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How many times do I gotta say it? I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... what terrible timing...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Good timing. I was just challenging her to a match. Told her she ought to step onto my turf for once."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —It's a matter of who takes down their prey first.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"And then you showed up. At the absolute perfect time.
Meaning... you get it, right?"
"Could it be... that I am the prey here?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...This ain't a real match.
It's just a farce. Just tune it out."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you sure? It's a rare chance, you know.
To experience a whole new kind of numbness, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Relationships with others are a tug-of-war.
Who falls first, or who can drag the other down.
Dragging them down requires a matching level of mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Living on the edge, the thrills and excitement...
Are you really sure you don't wanna taste that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………
I have no interest in foolish games. But—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

Nakayama Festa seems undecided
on whether this counts as a gamble or not, but—

Nakayama Festa seems undecided
on whether this counts as a gamble or not, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hoh... Now you've said it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this.
This ain't just playing around—it's a real, serious match.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This heartbeat. A heart, a will——... emotion.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's different from footprints. Once it's etched there,
it burns in deep. You can't just wipe it away easily.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why it is worth betting on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Let's make a special bet.
Wager this troublesome thing called 'sentiment.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's see who can leave a deeper mark on the other's heart... It's on.

Hearing Nakayama Festa say something so uncharacteristic,
I was thrown into absolute shock...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha! Hahahaha!!
Ahhahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! Look at the expression on this guy's face!
He's completely head over heels!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: At this rate, looks like there's no need for me to step in. I'll hand the victory to you. ...Be happy together, alright?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?
...You've gotta be kidding me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, wipe that smirk off your face already, will ya?
choice_data_list: But we were able to win, so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's because you're acting like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That was a pain in the ass of a match.
...Good grief, never doing that again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's see who can leave a deeper mark on the other's heart... It's on.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Eeee~~~~~k!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ngh, what the... !?

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, that wasn't a dream just now, was it...!?

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, please leave your mark upon my heart as well...!
Nakayama-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! Sounds like this new side of you
has brought out a whole swarm of worshippers, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's not a one-on-one tug-of-war anymore. Guess the match is a bust, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haa.
In the end, it was nothing more than a whimsical farce.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's how it is. Give me a real match, not child's play.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, no bites, huh?
Well then, let's save the fun for later."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll prepare a much more interesting match for you.
For example—betting the traces left upon our hearts, or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Whoever exposes what lies at the bottom of the other's emotions wins.
...Well? Doesn't it just send shivers down your spine?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
As troublesome as it is, it looks like it'll bring a considerable return.
I'll think about it.
